arcane-archer.summary: Enchant your arrows with crystal magic and loose spells straight from the bow.

assassin.summary: Slip into the shadows and strike for brutally devesatating hits.

captain.summary: Lead from the front, spending Inspirations to bolster yourself and your allies.

lurker.summary: Bide your time, let the enemy act first, then make them pay for it.

magus.summary: A dedicated caster with greater and more powerful spells than all others.

marksman.summary: Take aim, claim the high ground and pin down anything that steps into your sights.

sage.summary: A meta-mage that manipulates how spells are learned and cast in unique ways.

samurai.summary: Shift between sword stances, each honed with its own Bushido skills.

sentinel.summary: Raise your shield, guard your allies and draw the enemy's blows onto yourself.

skirmisher.summary: Dart in, strike and get out before the enemy can answer.

spellblade.summary: Channel crystal magic through your blade and unleash it with Spellstrikes.

spellslinger.summary: A spellcaster that likes to shoot spells rapid fire and shorten casting times.

warden.summary: A defensive spellcaster that focuses on protecting themselves and allies.
